text:
Anna (PM): quick quarterly ship-scrub — keeping this super short. what shipped, what slipped, owners + next actions. pls react or reply with confirmations.

Anna (PM): shipped: runtime-v2 on Dedicated (canary -> prod), model-catalog sync, console telemetry for per-route p99.
Maya (Eng): confirmed shipped. canary ran for 24h, no perf regression. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): shipped on our side, added quantization flags for aot builds. followups: add perf test for long-seq.
Connor (SRE): deploy-bot reported no infra errors but we saw 2x transient pod restarts during canary window. tracking with incident ticket INC-2026-07.
deploy-bot: deploy runtime-v2 canary -> prod completed at 2026-03-16T11:13:22Z (tag: `release/runtime-v2-20260316`).

Anna (PM): slipped: embeddings cache (reliability/eviction) — slipped ~2w due to edge-case on multi-tenant evict behavior. owner: @Maya.
Maya (Eng): yep, isolation bug reproduced. fix in progress, ETA next Tue (2026-03-23). mitigation: rollback cache on affected tenants, opt-out flag for 1% of traffic.
Eve (Design): FYI some product flows depend on cached similarity perf; will flag in docs and release notes.
Sam (Product): need an updated customer comms draft once we have rollback window. happy to draft, can someone drop a short bullet list of impact?
Maya (Eng): impact bullets: 1) transient 5-10% increase in embed latency for affected tenants; 2) rare stale hits leading to slightly lower similarity recall; 3) no data loss.
Sam (Product): thanks, will stitch into comms.

Anna (PM): owner confirmations / next actions:
- Maya (Eng): prod fix + opt-out rollout by 3/23 (update thread when merged)
- Connor (SRE): monitor p99 for embeddings, add alert if >2x baseline for >15m
- Sam (Product): draft comms + schedule to send after fix validated

Ravi (Eng): quick CR ping — I have a small follow-up for `kv-evict` in PR #4821, needs a second review. tagging @Maya.
Maya (Eng): on it, will take a look today.

Connor (SRE): also scheduling a small capacity buffer for Dedicated next week in case rollback causes spike. will notify billing if we need short-term burst capacity.

Anna (PM): any blockers to these owner actions?
Maya (Eng): none blocker-level. single test flake that slowed me yesterday but fixed.
Connor (SRE): no blockers, just coordination with infra for buffer.
Eve (Design): no blockers. adding a short note to the release notes doc.

Anna (PM): great. please react with :white_check_mark: when your action is complete so I can close this thread. I'll ping again Friday for an async status update.
Maya (Eng): :white_check_mark: will update when PR merged (PR #4821).
Ravi (Eng): :white_check_mark: reviewed and left lgtm comment.
Connor (SRE): will post capacity update here after change is scheduled.
Sam (Product): draft comms ready, holding until Maya confirms fix.

Anna (PM): thanks all — keeping this short helped. if anything changes ping me directly.
